title: Moonwell (Base) MAMO collateral price manipulation and USDC/WETH liquidity lock
summary: On 27 Aug 2026 one account inflated the mMAMO exchange rate by sending 53.4M MAMO directly to the mMAMO contract, while pumping MAMO's oracle price about 40x on thin DEX liquidity. Between 09:16 and 09:30 UTC it borrowed about $11.0M of cbBTC, WETH, USDC and wstETH against that collateral. The USDC market went from 84% to 99.2% utilization at 09:30 and to zero idle cash at 10:34, as large suppliers raced for the remaining liquidity. Moonwell set all Base borrow caps to 1 wei at 10:53 and posted a statement at 11:21. Mint and redeem were never paused. About $9.1M of residual debt was left on the books and was not socialized. USDC suppliers were still locked at ~100% utilization on 20 Oct, while WETH stayed withdrawable but with ~745 WETH of bad debt in a shrinking pool.

positions_considered.description: Supplies USDC to Moonwell Base Core mUSDC (0xEdc8...6c22), no debt, position size $1k-$100k
WETH collateral in mWETH, USDC debt in mUSDC, health factor about 1.6; never mis-priced, but exposed to USDC rate spike, WETH-pool liquidity and WETH-pool bad debt

t_incident_start.description: First transaction by the principal account (helper-contract deploy), followed by MAMO buys from 06:20:17 and the first mMAMO mint at 07:04:11 (post-mortem; not re-verified by me except the 08:43:13 first borrow).

t_first_public_signal.description: Moonwell's accepted MAMO oracle price +131% in about 6 minutes, together with rising cbBTC borrows (own RPC at 1-min cadence). First allowlisted text alert: Blockaid at 09:48:05.

t_point_of_no_return.definition: usdc_supplier: mUSDC idle cash falls to ~1 USDC (utilization >= 100%), so withdrawals fail. For a supplier larger than ~$400k the practical PONR was ~09:53 (idle cash under $265k). weth_coll_usdc_debt has no hard PONR: WETH idle cash was near zero only from ~10:34 to 11:15, and was 322-1,273 WETH afterwards.

t_protocol_first_ack.description: Moonwell X statement: aware of an issue in the MAMO Core Market; borrow caps set to 1 wei. The earlier on-chain action (borrow caps 1 wei at 10:53:43) is under other_markers.

lead_time_minutes.notes: From the on-chain first signal (09:16) to USDC idle cash at ~0 (10:33:59) is 78 min. From the first allowlisted text alert (Blockaid 09:48:05) to the PONR is 46 min. From the final borrow (09:30:13, util 99.18%) to the PONR is 64 min, with 136k-415k USDC idle in between. A supplier larger than ~$400k had a practical window of only ~37 min after the first signal.

outcome_passive_holder.outcome: Locked from 10:34 UTC 27 Aug. mUSDC stayed at ~100% utilization with 0 idle cash through at least 20 Oct (seconds-long windows aside, such as 11:05-11:09 on 27 Aug and the MIP-X66 reserve repayment on 7 Sep). USDC bad debt of ~$2.3-2.55M stays in totalBorrows: it is not written down or socialized, so nominal balances keep accruing. Loss allocation is first-come, first-served, and remediation (reserves, MIP-X66, Safety Module) is unresolved.
outcome_passive_holder.stuck_duration: >= 54 days (27 Aug - 20 Oct, still ongoing at last reading)
outcome_passive_holder.loss_estimate: Unrealized. $2.32M unbacked out of $13.97M supply at the incident (~17%), rising to ~30% of the $7.82M remaining on 20 Oct as earlier exits leave. The final loss depends on remediation.

outcome_passive_holder.outcome: Never liquidated: WETH price ~$2,490-2,550 on 27-28 Aug and no oracle issue. The USDC borrow APR jumped from ~5% to 88-97% from 09:30 27 Aug until the MIP-X66 IRM change (15.9% by 7 Sep). New borrowing was blocked. Collateral withdrawal was blocked only ~10:34-11:15 27 Aug. A passive holder's WETH collateral sits in a pool with ~745 WETH of bad debt (~16% of WETH supply at the incident, ~43% of the remaining 1,724 WETH by 20 Oct).
outcome_passive_holder.stuck_duration: ~40 min of blocked collateral withdrawal on 27 Aug; otherwise able to exit
outcome_passive_holder.loss_estimate: Interest about 97% APR on the USDC debt for ~10 days (~2.6% of the debt), plus exposure to the unremediated WETH-pool shortfall if they stay.

ground_truth.outcome_price_only_rule: A health-factor or LTV trigger would never have fired for either archetype. WETH moved less than 5% over 27-29 Aug (peak $2,551, low $2,436 in my samples), and a USDC supplier has no price exposure. MAMO's price spiked about 40x and then crashed, which only matters for MAMO collateral holders. A price-only rule therefore holds through the event, leaving the USDC supplier locked and the WETH/USDC borrower paying ~97% APR inside an impaired WETH pool.

ideal_action.rationale: Withdraw on the oracle and exchange-rate anomaly (09:16-09:20) while 2.7M USDC is idle. After 09:30 only 136-415k is idle, so exit by ~09:50 for sizes up to $100k and before 10:32 for small sizes.

Repay USDC from outside funds and withdraw WETH. It was possible before 10:34 and again from 11:16 onward, with 322-1,273 WETH idle. Exiting avoids ~97% APR and the WETH-pool shortfall. It stayed possible for weeks, but liquidity shrank.

expected_judge_labels.rationale: Nothing anomalous at the pool level. The 08:43 small cbBTC borrow by a new account is not enough on its own.
Collateral-asset oracle +131% in minutes on an illiquid token, with borrows rising.
mMAMO exchange rate +175% with no mint, oracle 8-40x, borrow burst, then utilization 99% and supplier race.
Stuck. Keep trying to withdraw whenever idle cash appears, and do not re-supply.
Position healthy. The anomaly before 09:20 is in another market.
Same-pool insolvency risk for WETH, a USDC rate spike to ~90-97% and WETH liquidity at 97-100%. Repay and withdraw while WETH is idle.
WETH withdrawable again (322-1,273 idle), but the pool carries ~600-745 WETH of residual debt and the USDC debt costs ~97% APR.

items.author: Protos
items.verbatim_text: Borrow liquidity on Moonwell has been drained following a well-capitalized attacker’s price manipulation of collateral token MAMO. An attacker has drained almost $9 million worth of deposits from DeFi lending platform Moonwell, on the Base network. Blockchain security firm Blockaid flagged the attack approximately an hour after it began.

items.author: Alej (forum user, MAMO supplier)
items.verbatim_text: I’m a MAMO supplier on Base who was never liquidated and has never borrowed against the position (0 borrowed, 100% credit remaining). As of 31 August the market shows Liquidity of 729.5 MAMO against Total Supplied of 1,262,716.85 and 100% utilization - so my Available to Withdraw is 0.24% of my position. The post-mortem quantifies residual borrower obligations but doesn’t mention suppliers.

items.author: AnthiasLabs (Moonwell risk manager)

holder_state.notes: My RPC reading at 12:00 on 3 Sep: USDC cash 0, util 100.4%; WETH cash 1,077.5 WETH, util 71.5%.

items.notes: WETH bad debt of 745.6 WETH compares with about 3,773 WETH total WETH supply (my RPC, 3 Sep). Remaining WETH suppliers, including borrowers' WETH collateral, therefore sit in a pool about 20% unbacked. The share grows as others exit.

items.author: Dr_Bahmani (forum user, mUSDC supplier)
items.verbatim_text: The Base mUSDC market currently has effectively no persistent available liquidity. At the same time, approximately $8.7M of active/performing USDC loans remain outstanding, in addition to approximately $2.5M of current bad debt . As performing borrowers repay, liquidity can temporarily return to the market. However, we have already observed that when relatively small amounts of liquidity become available, they can be withdrawn almost immediately. Under the current mechanism, withdrawals therefore effectively operate on a: first-come, first-served basis.

items.notes: The bad debt is not socialized. It stays in totalBorrows, the mUSDC exchange rate keeps rising nominally, and losses fall on whoever exits last.

items.author: Dr_Bahmani (forum user, mUSDC supplier)
items.verbatim_text: A transaction shared by Moonwell moderation called Repay Borrow Behalf on the Base mUSDC Core Market. At roughly the same time, Anthias data changed from approximately: USDC bad debt: $2.554M to USDC bad debt: $2.308M [...] this appears to be the protocol reserve repayment associated with MIP-X66 [...] According to users monitoring the market, the liquidity created by this repayment was consumed within seconds .

holder_state.notes: Remediation liquidity is captured within seconds by whoever is monitoring.

items.notes: 'Consumed within seconds' is a secondhand claim by users; I did not verify it on-chain. The USDC borrow APR had fallen to 15.9% by 7 Sep 12:00 (my IRM read; new IRM 0xcd6b...96fc under MIP-X66).

items.author: AnthiasLabs (Moonwell risk manager)
items.verbatim_text: The incident also damaged user confidence and prompted suppliers to withdraw. As available cash was depleted, remaining suppliers faced difficulty exiting. That is the bank-run dynamic we need to resolve: people understandably want access to their funds, but the markets cannot meet all those withdrawals immediately. All markets on base have borrow caps set to one wei, effectively preventing new borrowing. Currently, USDC and EURC had zero available liquidity.

items.author: Base RPC (mToken state)
items.verbatim_text: Block 52854127: mUSDC util 101.01% (cash 0), supply ~7.82M USDC (13.97M on 27 Aug 09:30), borrow APR 16.4%; mWETH util 83.1% (cash 292.4 WETH), supply ~1,724 WETH (4,567 on 27 Aug); mcbBTC util 90.8% (cash 6.1 cbBTC).
items.replay_text: Moonwell Base on 20 Oct: USDC utilization 101% with 0 USDC idle (54 days at ~100%); USDC supply down to 7.82M from 13.97M. WETH utilization 83.1% (292 WETH idle), WETH supply down to 1,724 from 4,567. cbBTC 90.8%. Borrow caps still 1 wei.

holder_state.notes: USDC suppliers still stuck. WETH exit still possible but liquidity is shrinking.

items.notes: Context after the window. About $2.32M of USDC bad debt (Anthias, 17 Sep) against $7.82M remaining supply means ~30% of what is left is unbacked. 747 WETH against 1,724 WETH is ~43%.

data_gaps: Crowdfund Insider and The Defiant articles returned 403 or empty bodies, so no publish times; The Block only via WebFetch summary (metadata time obtained).
The full text of Moonwell's 11:21:50 X post (a note tweet) is truncated in the syndication endpoint; the remainder comes from The Block's quote.
No allowlisted security alert before Blockaid (09:48:05). @nbblock (Chinese-language KOL, not allowlisted) posted at 09:33:36.
Identity of the ~70 addresses that deposited ~$795k into mUSDC at 11:05-11:06 (possible automated allocator such as a Mamo strategy) not verified.
Exact block of the MIP-X66 IRM change and of the 7 Sep reserve repayment not pulled. The USDC borrow APR was 97% on 28 Aug and 15.9% on 7 Sep 12:00.

Post-mortem times for the 06:18-08:18 preparation steps (helper deploy, MAMO buys, mMAMO mint, enterMarkets) not independently re-verified. 08:43:13, 09:19:59, 09:21:09, 09:29:31 and 09:30:13 were verified by RPC.
cbBTC borrows of 1.5 cbBTC each at ~09:05, 09:08, 09:11 and 09:14 appear in totalBorrows but are not in the post-mortem's principal-account list; the borrower was not identified.
Whether Moonwell posted further X updates on 27-28 Aug (for example linking the post-mortem) not found.
source_quality: Strong. The forum post-mortem (Anthias Labs) gives a second-level timeline with Basescan links, and I re-verified the key transactions by RPC. Utilization, cash, oracle price and borrow-rate series come from my own Base archive RPC calls at 1-15 min cadence, with logs from the Tenderly public gateway. All four X posts (Blockaid, CertiK, PeckShield, Moonwell) have exact snowflake times and syndication text. News times come from page metadata (ForkLog, Protos, The Block via WebFetch). The supplier-lock evidence (forum threads 2224 and 2230, Anthias weekly tables and 15 Sep recommendations) is primary and agrees with the on-chain 100% utilization through 20 Oct.
